stages.rule: Internal authoring slots are resolved only from the reviewed mapping and are never supplied by an application user.

The replacement key set must exactly equal implementation.parameters. Replacements are trusted SQL fragments; data values should normally be represented by driver bind placeholders and supplied separately as bindValues.

securityRules: Never substitute raw end-user text into an operational tag.
Validate and quote identifiers using the target Oracle driver's identifier policy.
Use Oracle bind variables for data values wherever the template position permits.
Conditions, expressions, column lists and subqueries come only from trusted application configuration.
Reject missing tags, extra tags, nested tag delimiters and any residual tag after rendering.
